sentences.en: Fadil always used his heartless scare tactics to control Dania.
sentences.zh: 法迪尔总是用他冷酷的恐吓手段来控制达尼亚。

sentences.en: That reverse psychology tactic isn't going to work with me.
sentences.zh: 那种逆向心理战术对我没用。

sentences.en: I suggest we adopt flexible tactics for the moment.
sentences.zh: 我建议我们现在采取灵活的战略。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：tact（接触）+ic→和（别人）接触的学问→策略
